title: Snail shell
instructions: Follow the circles in order to the X using only 2 commands. Look closely at how long each side of the spiral is.
hint: The sides go 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, and so on. You can put math inside the ( ) of a command. With int, / throws away the remainder, so 2 / 2 and 3 / 2 are both 1.
